input_requirement: Once System-A has successfully validated a settlement request, System-A must send an acknowledge message to System-B.

ambiguities.fragment: once System-A has successfully validated a settlement request,
ambiguities.explanation: The phrase can be parsed in two ways, leading to different interpretations of when the acknowledge message should be sent.
possible_interpretations: Acknowledge is sent after validation but before any other action (immediate acknowledgment).
Acknowledge happens only if System-A has completed all subsequent actions related to processing a settlement request beyond just validating it.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: once System-A has successfully validated a settlement request,
ambiguity_resolubility.missing_information: Specific sequence of actions following validation that determines when the acknowledge message is sent.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text does not specify whether 'once' refers to an immediate acknowledgment after successful validation or if it implies additional processing steps must be completed before sending the acknowledge.
